description: This PHP class defines the ReviewerRatingModel, a data transfer object (DTO) representing approval ratings related to performance reviews within the HRM system. It implements normalization functionality, serialization traits, and maps entity data for API responses.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing and exposing ReviewerRating data via the API, including properties like id, rating, comment, and related KPI id.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReviewerRating entity and sets up property filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
